enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Resistance +4: Passive: +4 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Acid Absorption +18%: Passive: 18% Enhancement Bonus to Acid Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Fortification +70%: +70% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Temple's Monolith: 2 Pieces Equipped:+5 Artifact Bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+10 Artifact Bonus to Acid Spell Power+10 Artifact Bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
